name: Beth El
overview: Beth El, originally known as Luz, is a significant biblical location north of Jerusalem where key patriarchs established worship practices. Abraham first built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD, marking it as a place of divine encounter and dedication. Jacob later experienced a profound vision of a ladder reaching to heaven at Beth El and was instructed by God to return and build an altar, reaffirming its spiritual importance. These accounts emphasize Beth El as a sacred site of covenantal relationship between God and His people.
